history.text: How often do I use the cream?

meaning: The customer asks whether their eight-year-old daughter can also use the eye drops.

history.text: How do I get to the beach from here?

history.text: Pots anar-hi caminant o en bus.

meaning: It is about a 25-minute walk; go straight ahead until you reach the sea.

meaning: The customer is allergic to shellfish and must not have any crab or shrimp, including the shrimp paste in the kangkong.

history.text: Room 314, ser. Breakfast alas siete hangtod alas diyes.

meaning: Guest Delgado in room 314 asks for a late checkout on Sunday at around 3 pm.

history.text: The aircon in my room isn't working.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Pasensya kaayo, ser. Unsa'y room number?

meaning: The receptionist will send the technician Dodong to fix the aircon in room 508 within fifteen minutes.

meaning: The mother asks how many ml of the 250 mg/5 ml paracetamol syrup her six-year-old son should take and how often.

meaning: The 500 mg amoxicillin capsule is taken three times a day, while the cough syrup is taken only twice a day.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Diretso lang, dayon liko sa wala sa simbahan.

history.text: The big church with the bell tower?

history.text: Oo, ang Basilica. Tapad ra niya.

meaning: The tourist asks whether Magellan's Cross is open now or only in the morning.

meaning: The rider should get off the 04L jeep at the last stop next to Gaisano, about 25 minutes away.

history.text: I'm from Seattle, first time in Cebu.

history.text: Nindot! Nakatilaw na ka sa lechon?

meaning: The visitor from Seattle says the lechon was honestly the best thing she has ever eaten.

history.text: What do you do on weekends?

text: Tagay mi sa barkada, videoke hangtod kadlawon, kuyaw kaayo bay
meaning: On weekends the Mandaue local drinks with friends and sings videoke until dawn, which he says is a blast.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you clean it for me?

meaning: The buyer wants half a kilo of cleaned squid at 280 pesos per kilo plus about ten calamansi.

text: Ugh no way, just take whatever route's fastest, I'm hella late
meaning: The passenger tells the driver to take the fastest route to SM Seaside because he is very late.

history.text: Gusto ka og dessert? Leche flan o halo-halo?

text: I'm lactose intolerant, can you make mine with no diary and no ice cream?
meaning: The customer is lactose intolerant and asks for the halo-halo without milk or ice cream.

text: magsira alas nuybe sa gbii, pro ang gym 24 oras bkas
meaning: The sixth-floor pool closes at 9 pm, but the gym is open 24 hours.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Do you have something for headache?

history.text: Medyo, sa Beverly Hills pa. Ang akong ig-agaw si Nonoy naay motor.

meaning: Yes, cousin Nonoy can take the tourist by motorbike, but she should pay him only 120 pesos and not more, or he will get used to it.

history.text: Buenas, ¿qué le pongo? Los tomates están a 2 euros el kilo.

history.text: Sí, muy maduros. Los melocotones a 3 euros el kilo.

meaning: The customer wants 1.5 kg of peaches and 2 kg of tomatoes.

history.text: Oh no. Can the kitchen make the chicken without the sauce?

history.text: Sí, puedo pedirlo a la plancha, sin salsa.

history.text: Aquí tiene su ibuprofeno de 400 miligramos.

history.text: How many should I take a day?

history.text: Una pastilla cada ocho horas, máximo tres al día, con comida.

history.text: No, para él mejor un jarabe infantil.

meaning: The parent asks how many milliliters of children's syrup to give their 9-year-old son and how often, noting he weighs about 30 kg.

text: ill take a kilo and a half of the cherrys and some figs
meaning: The customer wants 1.5 kg of cherries and an unspecified amount of figs.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you take me to the airport?

history.speaker: B
history.text: Može, do zračne luke je oko 35 eura.

meaning: The driver says one suitcase is included in the 35-euro fare and a second suitcase costs 3 euros extra.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Danas imamo rižoto s gljivama i tjesteninu s pestom.

meaning: The allergic diner asks whether the mushroom risotto is cooked in the same pan as the pesto pasta, which contains pine nuts.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Hi, we have a booking for two nights.

text: Je, doručak je od 6:30 do 9:30, al kava je bez veze, bolje skoknite u kafić preko puta.
meaning: The receptionist says breakfast is included from 6:30 to 9:30, but the coffee is bad and the guests should pop over to the café across the street.

history.speaker: B
history.text: Ovo je sirup protiv kašlja za djecu.

history.speaker: A
history.text: My son is 8. How much should he take?

text: Can I give it with good or only on an empty stomach?
meaning: The parent asks whether the 5 ml dose of cough syrup for the 8-year-old can be given with food or only on an empty stomach ('good' is an autocorrect error for 'food').

text: Desetak minuta pjeske, skrenite kod ljekarne pa idite uz stepenice.
meaning: The local says the cathedral is about ten minutes on foot: turn at the pharmacy and then go up the stairs.

text: yeah first time, gotta say the vibes here are unreal, been chilling at the beach all arvo
meaning: The visitor says it is their first time in Split, the atmosphere is amazing, and they have been relaxing at the beach all afternoon.

meaning: The vendor says the local red Istrian tomatoes are sweeter, but the yellow Italian ones last longer in the fridge.

history.text: What about dairy? I can't have milk.

meaning: The server says the gluten-free cake unfortunately contains cream and butter, but the lemon sorbet is dairy-free.

history.text: The AC in my room isn't working.

meaning: The guest says the room is 308 and asks that the technician sent for the air conditioning also check the safe that won't open.

history.text: I need something for a headache.

meaning: The pharmacist says to take one 500 mg paracetamol tablet at a time, at most 4 per day, with doses 6 hours apart.

history.text: What do people do for fun here?

meaning: The local says Vis is excellent but is packed like sardines on weekends, so it is better to go on a weekday.

meaning: The customer says the homemade honey is really amazing, but 15 euros is expensive, and offers 11 euros instead.

history.text: Which one makes you less sleepy?

meaning: The customer chooses loratadine and asks how many tablets are in a pack and whether one tablet a day is enough.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is the bus station far from here?

history.text: Can I walk there with a big suitcase?

meaning: The local says the traveler can walk the 800 meters, but it is uphill and they will sweat a lot, so it is better to take bus number 9.

meaning: The tourist wants to buy half a kilogram of dried apricots.

history.text: Can you do 800 dram for two kilos?

history.text: Where are the Matenadaran and the Blue Mosque?

history.text: I'll go to the closer one first.

history.text: What is that long thing with nuts inside?

meaning: The buyer wants four sujukh and two lavash flatbreads.

meaning: The driver says he doesn't accept cards, only cash (autocorrected 'կանխիկ' to 'կանխել').

history.text: Do I need a prescription for amoxicillin?

history.text: 品川駅ですね。何口がいいですか？

history.text: はい、カレーには少し入っています。

text: 唔該，麻煩送多四條毛巾上房，仲有個瘋筒壞咗。
meaning: The guest asks for four more towels sent to the room and reports that the hair dryer is broken.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Take one tablet every eight hours after meals.

text: 咁我夜晚瞓咗，使唔使扎醒食？
meaning: The patient asks whether they need to wake up at night to take a tablet.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Excuse me, which way to the Peak Tram?

history.speaker: B
history.text: 行去花園道，大約十分鐘。

text: 有少少斜，見到聖約翰坐堂就差唔多到。
meaning: The local says the walk is slightly uphill, and the tram is close once you see St John's Cathedral.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Is that your dog in the photo?

history.speaker: B
history.text: 係呀，佢叫豆豆，我阿妹養嘅。

history.speaker: A
history.text: So cute! Does it live with you?

text: 唔係，佢搬咗去英國，所以佢而家同我阿媽住。
meaning: The speaker's sister moved to the UK, so the dog Doudou now lives with the speaker's mother.

text: 細盒廿二蚊，你要嘅話我幫你簡過啲靚嘅。
meaning: The vendor says a small box costs HK$22 and offers to pick out the best lychees.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Can you hurry? My ferry leaves at 9:40.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Central Pier, the boat to Mui Wo.

text: 放心，包你趕得切，呢個鐘數條路好鬆。
meaning: The driver assures the passenger they will make the 9:40 ferry because the roads are clear at this hour.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Your friend Mr. Lam left a package at reception.

history.speaker: A
history.text: Yes, and there's also a letter addressed to Ms. Chan.

text: 封信唔係我嘅，係佢老婆嘅，麻煩你留低畀佢。
meaning: The guest says the letter belongs to Mr. Lam's wife, Ms. Chan, and asks reception to hold it for her.
